meta.name: deepspot-m
meta.description: Generate transcriptome-wide virtual spatial transcriptomics from H&E histology with DeepSpot-M. Use when you need spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM for 224x224 tiles at about 20x, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or want to run prediction across a whole slide after tiling with histolab.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测组织切片上每个位置的基因表达
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做病理或肿瘤研究,希望从常规染色切片得到基因表达数据
copy.tagline_en: Predict gene expression at every location from tissue slide images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study pathology or tumors and want gene expression from routine tissue slides

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 DeepSpot-M 从 H&E 组织切片生成虚拟空间转录组数据：对每个 224×224 小图，为查询的每个基因输出一个 log1p-CPM 表达值，覆盖约 19k 个蛋白编码基因。
howto.when: 当需要从 H&E 切片预测空间基因表达（224×224 小图、约 20 倍放大、log1p-CPM 单位），或想按基因符号查询蛋白编码基因，或想对整张切片跑预测（先用 histolab 切块）时触发。

say.text: 用 DeepSpot-M 预测这个小图的 EPCAM 表达值
say.note: 需确保图片为 224×224、约 20 倍放大

say.text: 把这张切片按 histolab 切块，再跑全片转录组预测
用 scgpt 嵌入源查询 CD3D 在肿瘤区域的表达
say.note: 也可换 evo2 等嵌入源

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use DeepSpot-M to generate virtual spatial transcriptomics from H&E histology: for each 224x224 tile, it outputs one log1p-CPM expression value per queried gene, covering ~19k protein-coding genes queryable by symbol.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need spatial gene expression (log1p-CPM) from 224x224 H&E tiles at about 20x, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or want whole-slide prediction after tiling with histolab.

say_en.text: Use DeepSpot-M to predict EPCAM expression for this tile.
say_en.note: Ensure the image is 224x224 at about 20x.

say_en.text: Tile this slide with histolab, then run whole-slide transcriptome prediction.
Query CD3D expression in the tumor region using the scgpt embedding source.
say_en.note: Other sources like evo2 are also available.
